title: Pan-fried turkey with roasted tomatoes and chive potatoes
blurb: Turkey cutlets cooked until golden, served with soft roasted tomatoes and buttery new potatoes tossed with chives and shallot.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the new potatoes and put them in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 12 minutes until tender.
While the potatoes cook, halve the tomatoes and place them cut-side up on a baking tray, drizzle with half the olive oil, season with salt and pepper, then roast for 20 minutes.
Peel and finely slice the shallot. Snip the chives into short lengths.

Season the turkey cutlets on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the cutlets for 4 minutes each side until cooked through and golden.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan with the butter, shallot and most of the chives. Toss gently until the butter melts and coats everything.
Serve the turkey with the potatoes and roasted tomatoes on the side, scattered with the remaining chives.
